sheets.title: Chapter 3 Problem Set, Part 2: Forced Oscillations, Resonance and Variation of Constants
sheets.lead: Complete, step-by-step solutions to the nine exercises of the second Chapter 3 sheet: eleven inhomogeneous initial value problems by undetermined coefficients, superposition, beats and resonance, the damped forced oscillator (amplitude and phase), higher-order equations, variation of constants, the structure of IVP solutions and reduction of order for inhomogeneous equations.
next: Chapter 4 Part 1: Systems and Real Eigenvalues
sheets.desc: Step-by-step solutions to all 9 exercises: eleven forced IVPs, superposition, beats and resonance, amplitude and phase of the damped forced oscillator, third- and fourth-order equations, variation of constants, splitting an IVP solution, and reduction of order.

sheets.title: Chapter 4 Problem Set, Part 1: Linear Systems, Elimination and Real Eigenvalues
sheets.lead: Complete, step-by-step solutions to the eleven exercises of the first Chapter 4 sheet: higher-order equations as systems, superposition, Wronskian and general solution of linear systems, elimination with initial conditions, general solutions and phase portraits from eigen-data, decoupling of four matrices with real eigenvalues, the trajectories of an uncoupled system and a zero eigenvalue.
next: Chapter 4 Part 2: Complex and Repeated Eigenvalues
sheets.desc: Step-by-step solutions to all 11 exercises: reduction to first-order systems, superposition and Wronskian for systems, elimination method with initial conditions (seven systems), eight phase portraits from eigen-data, four decouplings, uncoupled trajectories and a zero eigenvalue.

sheets.title: Chapter 4 Problem Set, Part 2: Complex and Repeated Eigenvalues, Spirals and Improper Nodes
sheets.lead: Complete, step-by-step solutions to the eight exercises of the second Chapter 4 sheet: phase portraits and general solutions from complex eigen-data, canonical forms with Q = [u | w], independence of real and imaginary parts, building matrices from eigen-data, repeated eigenvalues with the Jordan chain, the nilpotent case and the full qualitative catalogue of linear portraits.
prev: Chapter 4 Part 1: Systems and Real Eigenvalues
sheets.desc: Step-by-step solutions to all 8 exercises: eight complex-eigenvalue portraits and their general solutions, four canonical forms, real and imaginary parts of eigenvectors, building matrices from eigen-data, five repeated-eigenvalue systems, the nilpotent case and nine qualitative portraits.
pills: E4: Independence of u and w
